description: Issue #196 (the planner half of #180): a profile that declares `dispatch_defaults` now PLANS. Before this the same profile stopped at load_error (exit 6) before an issue was read, so the field could only reach dispatch through a hand-edited plan. Two properties are pinned here that the accept alone would not give. (1) The declaration is ECHOED into plan.profile — that is the only channel to the dispatch runner, which reads plan.profile.dispatch_defaults and never opens the profile. (2) It is echoed CANONICALLY: the profile authors the four keys in max_turns/auto_yes/wait_timeout/no_infer order and the plan carries them in the contract's order, because the resolved profile is hashed WHOLE into the default run id (#157) and a passed-through object would fork that id on a cosmetic re-ordering. Diff this case against 45: the profile is `companions-absent` plus this one field, and the issue bytes are identical, so everything below `profile` is the same plan.
